title: Backward Persistence of Liveness
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word and $c$ a configuration of the stopped four-tape interpreter on input $x$. For natural numbers $s\\le t$, if the interpreter has not halted after $t$ steps from $c$, then it has not halted after $s$ steps from $c$.
replaced:
If the stopped table interpreter has not halted after $t$ steps from a
configuration, then it has not halted after any $s \le t$ steps from that
configuration (halting is absorbing).
